parsed.seniority_signal: 3-7 years of experience in AI/ML engineering
parsed.degree_signal: Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
parsed.notes:
All skills come from “What’s required”; no optional qualifications section is present. Technologies listed as alternatives or examples remain required criteria under the guide.
“AI/ML engineering” explicitly names AI/ML and ML engineering; “machine learning frameworks and libraries” separately supports machine-learning.
The 3–7-year range spans mid and senior thresholds; mid is inferred from the minimum requirement and flagged for review.
The highest degree named is master's; “or a related field” does not permit experience in place of a degree.
Technologies mentioned only in the company description or responsibilities are excluded.
